summary.text: Marcus Bryant is a Democrat member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 96, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Iberia, Lafayette, and St. Martin parishes. First elected in 2019, Marcus Bryant sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Natural Resources and Environment, and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Marcus Bryant's occupation as attorney, with an education at Southern University Law School (2004).

The House page lists Marcus Bryant's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Natural Resources and Environment, Ways and Means, Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Democratic Caucus, and Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
